author: cosplayeternity
quote:
Graphic don't save bad fps sorry: I went from playing 240 fps + games on 240hz 4 k monitor to a nightmare fps I think we had better fps in 2003 playing cs 1.6... 
Story is woke. And npcs feel like crazy idiots. 
Jason feels like a psychopath who is done with life
Sophia omg... She's just awful.
Game play is locked to 1 style on the main game mode. 
 There is no freedom only conséquences and this doesn't feel like an actual grand theft auto. 
The no cds is also a big bummer. But I guess we know why now. Because you knew people would ask for refunds and with physical devices you would be legally forced to refund. 
The middle missions and filters are super lengthy tedious and forced they don't feel like actual mission that we enjoy. They gel forced. They are not challenging at all.
For a game that has been in production for 13 years not having difficulty mode and toggles on and off to play the game however we want is crazy..I constantly wanted to toggle of that police remember thingy because it's super annoying. To have it on all the time . At certain point it gets tedious. 
The amount of. Bugs are huge. I don't feel like replaying this game again.  
The main characters are boring. 
Did I enjoy playing the game? 90% frustration 10 % omg finally I finished this: result no all chapters were heavy and super unbalanced for actually enjoyment. This feels like rdr2 but the game is completely different and makes GTA6 feel so bad because it lost what made it GTA.
I am disappointed that they didn't add more other main stories and characters and paths. And difficulty modes... For a game that cost 100$ it's so bad. I know they would probably release dlc with other story lines but I will not buy any dlc after this disappointment. My gameplay is finished but the game feels unfinished. And they are going to abuse it. Add online+ micro transaction, kill GTA 5 online mods. Force everyone to gta 6 add more configuration controls. But they are supposed to have added and thought of this over the 13 to 8 years of development not now. My god. A team of over 4000 devs.... They said. I bet only sam was actually developing in a team of 8 to 20 people. The rest are benefiting from Sam work. For an army of devs this is just pathetic.
